nl_prompt: Alert with high severity on WhatsApp when a person without a helmet is detected in the welding bay.
expected_yaml:
rule:
  name: no_helmet_welding_bay
  zone: welding_bay
  condition:
    object: person
    missing_ppe: helmet
  action:
    type: alert
    severity: high
    channel: whatsapp
  enabled: true

nl_prompt: Log to the dashboard when a forklift enters the pedestrian corridor.
expected_yaml:
rule:
  name: forklift_in_pedestrian_corridor
  zone: pedestrian_corridor
  condition:
    object: forklift
    action: entering
  action:
    type: log
    severity: medium
    channel: dashboard
  enabled: true

nl_prompt: Send a critical alert to all channels when three or more vehicles are standing in the emergency exit zone for more than 30 seconds.
expected_yaml:
rule:
  name: vehicles_blocking_emergency_exit
  zone: emergency_exit
  condition:
    object: vehicle
    action: standing
    duration_seconds: 30
    min_count: 3
  action:
    type: alert
    severity: critical
    channel: all
  enabled: true

nl_prompt: Send an email alert when a worker without a safety vest is detected in the chemical storage area.
expected_yaml:
rule:
  name: no_vest_chemical_storage
  zone: chemical_storage
  condition:
    object: person
    missing_ppe: vest
  action:
    type: alert
    severity: high
    channel: email
  enabled: true

nl_prompt: Log a low-severity dashboard entry when a vehicle exits the loading dock.
expected_yaml:
rule:
  name: vehicle_exiting_loading_dock
  zone: loading_dock
  condition:
    object: vehicle
    action: exiting
  action:
    type: log
    severity: low
    channel: dashboard
  enabled: true
